senses.sense_definition: A person or thing that displaces someone or something else, such as a piston or moving part in an engine.

examples.text: The engine uses a mechanical <w>displacer</w> to move air between the hot and cold cylinders.
New automation technology acted as a swift <w>displacer</w> of manual laborers across the factory floor.

senses.sense_definition: The funnel or cylindrical chamber in an apparatus used for chemical extraction or solution by displacement.

examples.text: The chemist poured the solvent directly into the <w>displacer</w> to begin the extraction process.
Make sure the glass <w>displacer</w> is securely clamped above the collection flask before heating.
